paite: TOUPA tuh hon chingpa ahi a; ka tasam kei ding hi.
heading: David La / TOUPA, Chingpa Muanhuai

paite: Ama'n loupa hing nou mitmet mun ah hon kualsak zel a; tui dai dide kiang ah hon pi zel hi.
Ka hinna ahon bawlhoihsak zel a, ama min ziak in diktatna lampi ah hon pi zel hi.
Ahi, sihna lim phaizang tawn mah leng, gilou himhim ka lau kei ding; nang ka kiang ah na om ngal a, na khetbuk leh na chiangkhun in hon khamuan zel hi.
Hon doute mitmuh in ka ma ah dohkan na bawlkhol a; ka lutang thau na nilh khin a, ka nou adimlet hi.
Pel lou in hoihna leh zahngaihna in ka damsung teng in hon zui zel ding ua; huchi in TOUPA' inn ah tangtawn in ka om nilouhta ding hi.
